result:
Round 247 passes. In the real browser, when Undo or Redo removes a group row that has focus, focus now moves to the next row's name button instead of being lost (falling back to the page body). I found no bugs. One row could not run: the purchased-route check, because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

**Browser results** (Playwright Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, fresh context per row, 0 page errors):
- **The bug itself:** I tried Undo (`Ctrl+Z`) with focus on each group-row control: name, fold, mute, solo, volume. I also tried Redo of an ungroup with both `Ctrl+Shift+Z` and `Ctrl+Y`, a folded group, and the outer group of a nested pair. Each time, focus lands on the Music name button, or on the Group 1 name in the nested case.
  - When the group is reached with the keyboard (`Tab`), the brass focus ring shows after Undo.
  - I added two cases of my own: a Stems+SFX group (focus goes to Stems), and Undo while audio is playing (focus goes to Music).
- **Comparison with the old code:** I ran the same script against the unfixed commit (869d767) on a second server. Focus is lost there on every one of those cases. Group counts, status texts, Undo/Redo button titles, row order, names and fader values match exactly in both versions. Only focus differs.
- **Neighbouring behaviour, unchanged from before:**
  - Ungroup (`Ctrl+Shift+G`) still sends focus to its own target.
  - Focus that was elsewhere is never moved: the Video track, a member track, or the empty page.
  - Rename followed by Undo keeps focus on the group name.
  - The toolbar Undo/Redo buttons behave as before.
  - Group volume: two volume steps undo one by one. The third Undo removes the group, and focus goes to Music.
  - Folding a group with `U` still puts focus on the group name with the ring.
  - Marker add-then-Undo still puts focus on Add marker.
  - Focus doesn't jump during 1.5 s of playback or while dragging the fader.
- **Smoke test:** play and pause work, and the export WAV matches the expected checksum. It is 16.000 s, 48 kHz, 24-bit stereo, and contains no invalid samples. The number of always-visible text lines is unchanged (85/101 and 69/85).
- **Auth:** a fresh session with no login opens `/studio-lab`. The purchased Studio page shows "Sign in required", and the token API returns 401. Premium access is not bypassed.

**Code and test checks:**
- The changed source matches B's pre-approved diff exactly. Frozen-file and protected-file hashes are unchanged.
- The 96 related test files pass (1,492 tests), with nothing close to its timeout.
- I broke the fix on purpose in 9 ways, on a copy outside the repo, and each break makes exactly the tests B listed fail. The repo was identical before and after.
- The implementation doc (190) meets every requirement.

**Two side checks (noted for the record, no bug filed):**
- With the lane grid menu open, `Ctrl+Z` does nothing. The old code does the same.
- Folding an outer group while an inner group has focus puts focus on the outer group's name.

**Not tested this round:** the video lane and fit-to-video, which aren't part of this round's checks. The full test suite, build and `npm run verify` are left to the root gate.

A's reviewer raised three Lows, which stay with B. I found no browser path that reaches any of them. One script note: run it with `'.'` as the row filter. Without a filter it silently skips the smoke, auth and budget rows.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-247.md
- c-round-247.json
- c-round-247/table.txt
